say:82:1064601032:1.female: Not so fast. We must figure out what happened and tighten up the palace's security.

say:83:1064601033:0.text: Besides, we still have to answer to Duke Conrad. Let's put our heads together and crack this case.
say:83:1064601033:0.source_cn: 公爵的要求有些无礼，但我也能理解他的担忧。我们一起想办法吧。
say:83:1064601033:0.male: Besides, we still have to answer to Duke Conrad. Let's put our heads together and crack this case.
say:83:1064601033:0.female: Besides, we still have to answer to Duke Conrad. Let's put our heads together and crack this case.

choice:42:2:3.text: No one else died, right? Why don't we just close the case?
choice:42:2:3.source_cn: 既然无人受伤，不如就这么结案吧！
choice:42:2:3.male: No one else died, right? Why don't we just close the case?
choice:42:2:3.female: No one else died, right? Why don't we just close the case?

choice:12:0:1.text: Thank the Duke on my behalf for his trust.
choice:12:0:1.male: Thank the Duke on my behalf for his trust.
choice:12:0:1.female: Thank the Duke on my behalf for his trust.

choice:12:1:2.text: Tsk, must be nice to just give orders.
choice:12:1:2.source_cn: 唉，他只要动嘴，我却要干活
choice:12:1:2.male: Tsk, must be nice to just give orders.
choice:12:1:2.female: Tsk, must be nice to just give orders.

choice:8:0:1.text: The security around here is woefully lacking.
choice:8:0:1.source_cn: 王宫防卫简直比我的钱包还薄
choice:8:0:1.male: The security around here is woefully lacking.
choice:8:0:1.female: The security around here is woefully lacking.

say:84:1064601008:1.text: So sorry we've let you down! With Hendrik away escorting Princess Peggy and no signs of magic involved, we're at our wits' end.
say:84:1064601008:1.source_cn: 对不起，亨德里克先生因陪同佩吉公主暂时不在宫内，因为看...
say:84:1064601008:1.male: So sorry we've let you down! With Hendrik away escorting Princess Peggy and no signs of magic involved, we're at our wits' end.
say:84:1064601008:1.female: So sorry we've let you down! With Hendrik away escorting Princess Peggy and no signs of magic involved, we're at our wits' end.

choice:8:1:2.text: I expected better from all of you!
choice:8:1:2.male: I expected better from all of you!
choice:8:1:2.female: I expected better from all of you!

say:85:1064601009:1.text: I know! But everyone seems to think you can solve anything...
say:85:1064601009:1.source_cn: 我当然知道！但没办法阻止其他人这么想……
say:85:1064601009:1.male: I know! But everyone seems to think you can solve anything...
say:85:1064601009:1.female: I know! But everyone seems to think you can solve anything...

choice:8:2:3.text: I'm a mage, not a detective.
choice:8:2:3.male: I'm a mage, not a detective.
choice:8:2:3.female: I'm a mage, not a detective.
